senses.gloss: m.bean (cmp. אפול s. v. אֲפוֹלִים). Y. Yoma IV, 43ᶜ bot. עד כא׳ only the size of a bean; v. חָאפוּן.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>וכא׳ היה</he> had the shape of a bean.—Pl. <he>אֲפוּנִים</he>, <he>אֲפוּנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:2">Kel. III, 2</cite> <he>א׳ הגמלונין</he> Ar., Ms. M. (ed. <he>הגמלנים</he>) large beans; v. <cite ref="C01047"><he>גַּמְלוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 21:3">Sabb. XXI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 143a:8">143ᵃ</cite>) <he>שער של א׳</he> (Ms. L. <he>עפ׳</he>; ed. Sonc. <cite ref="Q00232"><he>פולין</he></cite>) the silique of the bean. Teb. Yom I, 5; a. fr.
